Round 66 is ready to go. The decision is **CONTINUE**, and the next task is **SRW-15 stage 2: the metronome** (decision D-29z31, requirement R15-T2).

**What round 65 left us (from C's own checks):**
- C passed round 65 with real-browser checks (`browserVerified: true`) and found no bugs.
- Root published it as `3e55c5c` on both remotes, so nothing is waiting to be committed.
- SRW-15 stage 1 (the BPM field and bars ruler) is closed. FB-11 (tempo) is now marked **მოწმდება**: every C check passed and only the Tech Lead's feel check R65-T remains.
- The previous task is archived as `tasks/round-65.md` (a copy). The new baseline is HEAD `3e55c5c`, clean tree, 426/426 frozen files OK, Biome 4/218/1, tests 91/1605, both servers 200.

**The round-66 task (`current-task.md`):**
- **Button:** a `მეტრონომი` toggle in the tempo row. It is disabled until a BPM is set, off by default and not in undo history. Clearing the BPM turns it off.
- **Clicks:** a short synthesized click on every beat, louder on the first beat of each bar, so the loud clicks fall exactly on the bar numbers.
- **Routing:** the click goes through the Master, so Master volume and mute apply and the Master meter shows it. That meter is the only way C can measure live audio in a real browser. Live 12 sends the metronome through a separate Preview volume instead; I recorded this as a deliberate difference.
- **Playback:** clicks follow loops, seeks and edits. Turning it on or off, or changing the tempo during playback, restarts the schedule once.
- **Export:** unchanged. C must show the WAV is byte-identical with the metronome on, and that the silent lead-in before the first sound (0–4 s) contains only zero samples.
- **Size:** one owner. A new pure `metronome.ts`, add-only changes in `graph.client.ts`, listed edits in `ArrangementContext.tsx`, `StudioWorkspace.tsx` and `ArrangementTempoRow.tsx`, two new test files (expected 93 files / 1626 tests), 16 code-mutation checks (a–p) and doc 059.
- **One hard rule:** the click buffers are created only when the metronome is on. The existing frozen test mocks have no way to create audio buffers, so creating them earlier would break those tests.
- **C's checks:** the beat checks run at 40 BPM. At that tempo beats are 1.5 s apart, well above the meter's roughly 0.13 s timing jitter. C also checks the layout at both viewports and the anonymous-access and purchase-protection rows (G66-3).
- **Ableton:** the Live 12 manual §19.4 and §19.4.1 were captured on 2026-10-19 with gstack `/browse`. The accent on beat 1 and leaving the metronome out of export are not confirmed by that text, so they are marked unconfirmed.

**Calls I made on the round-65 notes:**
- A's extra `999.5` test value is now part of the spec.
- Root review Low #3 is closed: the status bar already announces changes to screen readers (`aria-live`).
- The other Lows and the missing unit test for clicking a focused grid dropdown go to the Lows batch.
- **The root review's Medium (too many beat marks in the bars strip) is not scheduled yet.** The advisor suggested hiding beats under 16 px in this round, but I didn't. Hiding them doesn't cap the worst case: the mark count grows with timeline width, about 12,000 marks for 10 minutes at maximum zoom. The real fix is drawing only the visible part, which is its own task. C measures the actual cost first (BD-INFO).

**Advisor:** used twice. The second review caught a gap: when playback is rescheduled, the old graph's clicks must stop at the scheduled handoff time. If they ignored that time they would be cut early or play twice after every edit. I added that rule plus one more code-mutation check that must catch it.

**For root:** the architecture review ARCH-CHECKPOINT-SRW14-PREFS is requested for the third time. It now covers the metronome as the first audio user of the tempo, plus a new question about simplifying the 6-condition focus-release check. Round 66 doesn't wait for it, because the two earlier requests were never answered. Two small items are root's to note or decide: INFO-R61-FAKEBEARER-500 and INFO-C65-LS-SESSION.

`backlog.json` (v68), `plan.md` (D-29z31) and `feature-status.md` were updated by scripts that saved a copy of each file first. I also restored the previous `b-next.json` as `b-next.before-b-round-65.json`, because I had overwritten it without a backup. No Store files were touched.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `current-task.md`
- `b-round-65.md`
- `b-next.json`
- `b-round-65-checkpoint.md`
